_readme: Edit this file to change the brand, prices, contact details, booking link and form handling. Then run: node build.js && node tests/check.js. Prices here are the only place prices live: every page reads them from here.

brand.name: Gainora
brand.tagline: Every call answered. Every enquiry followed up.

demo._readme: The 'Ring our receptionist' block stays hidden until both a phone number and a recording are set.

founding._readme: Set show to true to display the founding offers on the site. Off by default: mention them on calls.

prices._readme: All prices ex-VAT. Keep them in step with the Gainora Offer Brief.

forms._readme: netlify: forms post to Netlify Forms and arrive by email. Later, the owner can also forward each submission to the Capture & Convert inbox from the Netlify dashboard (Forms → notifications → outgoing webhook).
